title: singular.orchestration.ctx-experiment-armaudit.v0
description: A deterministic, strictly read-only audit of per-arm knob-state integrity across the runs corpus: it consumes the arm-knob-state.json provenance (singular.orchestration.ctx-experiment-armstate.v0) each run directory carries, joins each run to its arm via ctx.arm_assigned, and reports whether each arm actually ran with the expected knob-state so the experiment-report's escape / cost / bias attribution rests on validated arm integrity. It uses ONLY the generic arm boundary — a control-arm (A) run is consistent iff activeCount is 0 (the M0 knob-state) else contaminated; a treatment-arm (B) run is consistent iff activeCount is greater than 0 else misconfigured-as-M0 — and hardcodes NO specific treatment knob-set (that remains operator run-config). A run with no arm-knob-state.json is counted unrecorded for its arm (fail-safe), not an error. The audit only MEASURES arm integrity and reclassifies nothing. Keys are sorted and deterministic for a fixed input set. Additive under the singular.orchestration.*.v0 namespace; validation fails closed.

arms.description: Per-arm knob-state integrity rollup. Both arms (A = control / M0 knob-state, B = treatment) are always present.

expectation.description: The generic arm boundary this arm's runs are audited against (activeCount==0 for control, activeCount>0 for treatment).

inconsistentRuns.description: The inconsistent runIds with their offending knob-state, sorted by runId for determinism.
